title: Prism Equalizer Held Prop Mk.6

She performs a graceful windrunner breathing cadence and shifts her weight smoothly while her copper braided hair sways softly across her shoulder, offering an encouraging smile before settling seamlessly back into her starting stance. Locked static camera, clean solid white studio backdrop, no floating text or overlays. audio_script.script: Let's practice harmonic flow and crystal pulse together—every calm breath builds our guild sanctuary.
